alate: Head chestnut brown, pronotum, postmentum and tibiae yellow with a brownish tinge, labrum, postclypeus, antennae, femora and wings from yellowish brown to brownish yellow. Head capsule circular and slightly elongate, fontanelle dot-like, 0.47 and 0.54 from the frontal margin, the median suture of the head indiscernible. In profile the vertex is mound-shaped, the postclypeus projecting but distinctly lower than the vertex. Compound eyes nearly circular, protrusion 6%, short diameter slightly greater than or equal to the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head; ocelli nearly circular, short diameter nearly equal to the ocellus–compound eye distance. Antennae 16–17 segments. Pronotum about 1.52 times as wide as long, anterior margin straight, posterior margin with a shallow notch in the middle.
soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles dark brown, thorax dark yellow, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.53–0.54, lateral margins nearly parallel, slightly contracted near the middle, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal peaks distinct, shallowly concave between them. Labrum ligulate, apical, subapical and lateral apical setae present. Mandibles short and stout, apex rather curved; length 0.46–0.47 times head capsule length and 0.88 times head width. Antennae 15–16 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior sixth, waist region narrow and long, waist constriction index 0.33–0.35. Pronotum ob-trapezoidal, 1.52–1.57 times as wide as long, anterior margin shallowly concave, posterior margin nearly straight; about 30 setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.
